WF_complexity.name: Wootton-Federhen sequence complexity
WF_complexity.desc: Complexity based on SEG algorithm (Wootton and Federhen, 1993), blob length=IDR length, step size = 1

isoelectric_point.name: Isoelectric point
isoelectric_point.desc: pH where charge of peptide is neutral

ED_ratio.name: E/D ratio
ED_ratio.desc: Ratio of glutamic acid to aspartic acid residues (#E + 1)/(#D + 1)

RK_ratio.name: R/K ratio
RK_ratio.desc: Ratio of arginine to lysine residues (#R + 1) /(#K + 1)

SCD.name: Sequence charge decoration
SCD.desc: Measure of separation between positively versus negatively charged residues

DEG_APCC_KENBOX_2.name: APCC-binding Destruction motif
DEG_APCC_KENBOX_2.desc: Motif conserving the exact sequence KEN that binds to the APC/C subunit Cdh1 causing the protein to be targeted for  26S proteasome mediated degradation.

LIG_CaM_IQ_9.name: Helical calmodulin binding motif
LIG_CaM_IQ_9.desc: Helical peptide motif responsible for Ca2+-independent binding of the CaM . The motif is manly characterized by a hydrophobic residue at position 1, a highly conserved Gln at position 2, basic charges at positions 6 and 11, and a variable Gly at position 7

LIG_EH_1.name: EH ligand
LIG_EH_1.desc: NPF motif interacting with EH domains, usually during regulation of endocytotic processes

LIG_KLC1_WD_1.name: Motifs binding the TPR domain of kinesin light chain 1

LIG_LIR_Gen_1.name: Atg8 protein family ligands
LIG_LIR_Gen_1.desc: Canonical LIR motif that binds to Atg8 protein family members to mediate processes involved in autophagy.

LIG_PCNA_PIPBox_1.name: PCNA binding PIP box
LIG_PCNA_PIPBox_1.desc: The PCNA binding PIP box  motif is found in proteins involved in DNA replication, repair and cell cycle control.

LIG_SH2_CRK.name: Phosphotyrosine ligands bound by SH2 domains

LIG_SH2_GRB2like.name: Phosphotyrosine ligands bound by SH2 domains

LIG_SH2_NCK_1.name: Phosphotyrosine ligands bound by SH2 domains

LIG_SH2_SRC.name: Phosphotyrosine ligands bound by SH2 domains

LIG_SH2_STAP1.name: Phosphotyrosine ligands bound by SH2 domains

LIG_SH2_STAT5.name: Phosphotyrosine ligands bound by SH2 domains

LIG_SUMO_SIM_par_1.name: SUMO interaction site
LIG_SUMO_SIM_par_1.desc: Motif for the parallel beta augmentation mode of non-covalent binding to SUMO protein.

MOD_CDK_SPxK_1.name: CDK Phosphorylation Site
MOD_CDK_SPxK_1.desc: Canonical version of the CDK phosphorylation site which shows specificity towards a lysine/arginine residue at the [ST]+3 position.

MOD_DYRK1A_RPxSP_1.name: S/T residue phosphorylated by Arg- and Pro-directed DYRK1A kinase

MOD_SUMO_for_1.name: Sumoylation site
MOD_SUMO_for_1.desc: Motif recognised for modification by SUMO-1

TRG_ER_FFAT_1.name: FFAT motif
TRG_ER_FFAT_1.desc: VAP-A/Scs2 MSP-domain binding FFAT (diphenylalanine [FF] in an Acidic Tract) motif

TRG_NLS_MonoExtN_4.name: NLS classical Nuclear Localization Signals
TRG_NLS_MonoExtN_4.desc: Monopartite variant of the classical basically charged NLS. N-extended version.

ELASTIN_LIKE.name: Glycine motif
ELASTIN_LIKE.desc: Pentapeptide motif (VPG(X)G) derived from hydrophobic domain of tropoelastine, used in repeats for artificial elastin-like polypeptides.

REP_RGG.name: RGG repeat
REP_RGG.desc: Motif defined by R followed by exactly 2 glycines "RGG". This is distinct from a more generically defined 'glycine, arginine'=rich motif "RG", which is also computed and part of the full feature set.
